text: There is a breakpoint before the square function as shown below. When LabVIEW pause execution at that breakpoint, what will happen if you press the step into button?
options: LabVIEW will highlight the square function but will not execute.
LabVIEW will open up the block diagram of the square function to allow you to single step through the code inside the square function.
LabVIEW will execute the square function and then highlight the next node to be executed as you continue single stepping through the VI.
LabVIEW will complete the execution of the VI and return to the calling VI (if one exits).
